subject: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>, Novus Health Events <events@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint

Hi Elena / Events team,

Thanks again for the invite to run the three-day executive workshop in Boston. To avoid back-and-forth I drafted three parallel "time corridors" that map to your multi-region attendees and give us an onsite/virtual split that minimizes handoff friction. Attached: redwood-workshop-time-corridors.pdf and a set of provisional calendar holds (calendar-holds.ics).

Quick summary and asks:
- Proposed dates: Sep 20–22, 2026 (flexible if conflicts)
- Onsite day: Sep 21 (all-hands in Boston HQ conference A/B)
- Virtual days: Sep 20 & 22 with focused morning windows for APAC (08:00–11:30 AEST) and later afternoon windows for EU (14:00–18:00 CEST)
- Ask 1: Please confirm AV contact on site and room AV spec (so we can validate run-of-show)
- Ask 2: Confirm headcount we should plan for onsite catering & breakouts (current estimate: 18)
- Ask 3: Are there any procurement / visitor badge restrictions we should know about?

If those corridors look good, I will send final calendar holds per timezone and loop in our travel lead for team arrival windows.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Health Events <events@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear proposal. We like the corridors and the Sep 20–22 window works for the executive calendar. A few specifics:

- Onsite: Sep 21 confirmed (Boston, 3rd floor, Conference A/B).
- AV contact: Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@novushealth.com) — he manages the room feed and streaming link.
- Headcount: plan for 18 on site (12 internal Novus, 6 vendor/partners).
- Visitor access: all external attendees need to be pre-registered 48 hrs prior for lobby badges; we can provide a badge spreadsheet once names are final.
- Catering: light lunch + two coffee breaks; please provide dietary flags by Sep 6.

Attached: boston-av-specs.pdf (Marcus also sent the AV rack layout).

Two small asks from our side:
1) Could you map the corridor times to EDT/CEST/AEST explicitly in your calendar holds? Some of our EU execs prefer an end-of-day window (16:00–18:00 CEST).
2) We have one EU-based speaker (Lukas Meyer) who may need a visa/arrival escort — will your travel ops team handle that?

Thanks — Elena

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint

Elena — perfect, thanks for the quick confirmation and the AV spec. I made the mapping explicit and attached an updated final-time-corridor-v1.pdf that includes:

- Concrete UTC-aligned windows with local labels:
  • APAC morning: 08:00–11:30 AEST (Sep 20 / 22)
  • NA overlap: 08:30–12:00 EDT (Sep 20) and 13:00–16:30 EDT (Sep 22)
  • EU late window: 16:00–18:00 CEST (Sep 20 / 22)
- Onsite run-of-show (high level) for Sep 21 with three breakouts and one broadcast panel.
- Logistics asks: final badge list by Sep 18, AV check with Marcus on Sep 20 at 15:00 local, catering dietary list by Sep 6.

Action plan:
1) I will send timezone-specific calendar holds (one per attendee region) by EOD and include the event links.
2) Priyom, can you confirm travel arrival windows for the Redwood team and whether we should block one additional buffer day in case Lukas needs visa/escort?
3) Monica, would you own the vendor run through and the breakout facilitator roster?

Attachments: final-time-corridor-v1.pdf (schedule + runbook) and I will push calendar-holds.ics after we lock names.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint (internal)

Quick internal note — copying the two asks Rishi raised:
- Travel bookings: our preferred policy is to fly the team in on Sep 20 afternoon (arrivals 18:00–22:00 local) and depart Sep 22 late evening; budget cap per person is $1,200 for flights + $280/night for hotel. I will confirm hotel block and rate by EOD tomorrow.
- Visa/escort for Lukas Meyer: we will start the visitor badge / visa support flow immediately once Elena shares Lukas's passport name and DOB. If visa paperwork is required, we should plan a buffer arrival day (Sep 19) for him.

I'll update the calendar-holds.ics after rates/hotel block are confirmed.

— Priyom

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Novus Health Events <events@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating workshop time corridors & AV checkpoint

Thanks Rishi / Priyom — all sounds good. Marcus confirms the AV check on Sep 20 at 15:00 and will provide the stream endpoint by Sep 15. I will send the badge spreadsheet and Lukas's details by Aug 24.

Please go ahead and issue calendar holds per timezone — we will accept provisional holds and update names as they come in.

Forwarding previous thread for visibility.

Best,
Elena
